_meta.title: LUNAPOLE verified site catalogue
_meta.status: VERIFIED 2026-10-12 — coordinates cross-checked against IAU Gazetteer feature IDs cited in Wikipedia infoboxes
_meta.warning: A 'coord_source' of 'iau_via_wikipedia' means the number came from the IAU Gazetteer feature page cited in the article infobox. Re-confirm against planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov before anything is published or used for a real mission claim.
_meta.lon_convention: planetographic, -180..+180. East positive. Add 360 for 0..360 E.

sites.name: Shackleton
sites.interest: Closest named feature to the pole. Rim peaks see near-continuous sun; interior is a permanent shadow cold trap. THE reference site for any south-pole illumination demo.

sites.name: de Gerlache
sites.interest: Artemis III candidate region 'de Gerlache Rim 1/2' sits on this crater's rim. 1.5 deg from pole = extreme low sun, heavy topographic shadowing.

sites.name: Haworth
sites.interest: One of the 9 current Artemis III candidate regions. Rim is a candidate landing area.

sites.name: Nobile
sites.interest: Artemis III regions 'Nobile Rim 1/2'. NOTE: these are descriptors on the crater rim, NOT gazetteer features. Use crater centre as an anchor only.

sites.name: Malapert
sites.interest: Artemis III region 'Malapert Massif'. IM-1 (Odysseus) landed near Malapert A at 80.13S 1.44E — see clps_missions.json.

sites.name: Cabeus
sites.interest: Large shadowed crater, candidate for volatiles. Artifacts of distant-sun lighting make it a good demo contrast vs Shackleton.

rejected_from_original_spec._why: These appeared in the original README site table with unverified / invented coordinates. Do NOT use them without first resolving against the IAU Gazetteer.
rejected_from_original_spec.Connecting Ridge: No gazetteer feature by this name. Artemis III region descriptor, not an IAU name.
rejected_from_original_spec.Leibnitz-Beta plateau: No such feature. Leibnitz crater is at -38.17, 179.54 — nowhere near the pole. Original spec coords appear fabricated.
rejected_from_original_spec.Malapert Massif: Not an IAU name. Artemis descriptor for the Malapert massif area. Use Malapert crater anchor.
rejected_from_original_spec.Mount Mouton: Wrong type. The IAU feature is Mons Mouton (approved 2022, IAU 16070) — a mons, not a mountain.
rejected_from_original_spec.Nobile Rim 1/2: Not gazetteer features. Descriptors on the Nobile crater rim.
rejected_from_original_spec.de Gerlache-Kocher Massif: Informal composite. Use de Gerlache crater (IAU 1439).
rejected_from_original_spec.Slater Plain: Artemis III region descriptor, no gazetteer entry found.
rejected_from_original_spec.Peak near Cabeus B: Artemis III region descriptor, no gazetteer entry found.

artemis_iii_regions_current_9._source: NASA news release 28 Oct 2024, 'NASA Provides Update on Artemis III Moon Landing Regions'
artemis_iii_regions_current_9._note: NASA published NAMES only, no coordinates. Regions are ~15x15 km boxes. Region -> crater-centre anchor is our approximation, NOT an official mapping.

Mons Mouton Plateau.note: Mons Mouton IAU 16070 coords unresolved — verify
